metadata.title: Housing V1
metadata.company: Johnson Electric Group of Companies ('Johnson Electric')
metadata.author: M. Berthe

views.name: Main Top View
views.description: Primary top orthographic projection showing housing cavity, perimeter seal channel, motor cradle, gear cavity, and coordinate dimensioning rails

views.name: Top Connector Elevation View
views.description: Side view of electrical connector shroud, showing Datum Z reference line, snap latch elevation, and draft angles

views.name: Detail L
views.description: Magnified detail of 5-pin terminal arrangement showing pitch (2.5mm, 5.0mm), tip radii, chamfers, and GD&T true position frame

views.name: Section M-M
views.description: Longitudinal section cut through connector shroud revealing internal terminal retention shoulders, wall thicknesses, draft angle 6.7°, and Datum X2

views.name: Detail N
views.description: Enlarged view of snap-fit latch geometry (Snap 1-4) detailing retention window height (5.3mm), width (3.0mm), and corner radii

views.name: Section W-W
views.description: Cross-section through screw boss (Bores 1-3) showing screw pilot hole (Ø2.6mm), counterbore (Ø3.3mm), depth (2.8mm), and perimeter seal lip (0.9mm)

views.name: Section T-T
views.description: Transverse cross-section through housing body depicting internal stiffening ribs, motor cradle walls, and gear support axle bosses

views.name: Isometric 3D View
views.description: Perspective 3D rendering showing the assembled Housing V1 casing with embossed 'saia-burgess' brand logo on the output gear cap

features.name: Fastener Pilot Bores (Bore 1, Bore 2, Bore 3)
features.description: Three internal screw bosses with counterbores for securing upper and lower casing assembly

features.name: Perimeter Snap Latches (Snap 1, Snap 2, Snap 3, Snap 4)
features.description: Four cantilever snap-fit retention latches distributed along top, bottom, left, and right walls

features.name: External Mounting Flanges / Ears
features.description: Four slotted mounting ears with center crosshairs for chassis fastening

features.name: Electrical Connector Terminals (Pin 1 to Pin 5)
features.description: Five contact blade pins on 2.5mm / 5.0mm pitch with chamfered lead-ins and true position control

features.name: Perimeter Sealing Gasket Lip
features.description: Continuous raised perimeter seal rib for ingress protection (IP rating)

features.name: Saia-Burgess Brand Emblem
features.description: Embossed Saia-Burgess brand logo located on top circular gear cover

dimensions.measurement_note: Reference pin tip width associated with GD&T true position callout
Primary lead-in chamfer 0.3mm at 30° on both sides of 5 pins

dimensions.associated_feature: Section W-W Cutting Plane / Bore 1 Y-coord

dimensions.measurement_note: Two corners per snap latch x 4 snaps

gdt_controls.associated_feature: Electrical Connector Pin Blades (Pin 1 to Pin 5)

checks_passed: Hole Geometry Valid: Pilot bore Ø2.6mm is strictly smaller than counterbore Ø3.3mm
Pin Pitch Symmetry Valid: Outer pins symmetric at 5.0mm, inner pins symmetric at 2.5mm from Datum Y2
Pin Grid Pitch Consistency Valid: Outer pitch (5.0mm) is exactly 2x inner pitch (2.5mm)
Snap Latch Retention Clearance Valid: Snap window height (5.3mm) accommodates latch height (4.4mm)
All dimension tolerance bounds are positive and geometrically valid.
